The '''tactical theater''' was a room aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]. It contained tiered seating around a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holo-emitter]] and was used for discussing large operations.<ref name="Strongholds" />
